fireblight: ("fire blight" OR "Erwinia amylovora") AND FIG:(symptom* OR shoot* OR blossom* OR "shepherd's crook" OR orchard OR ooze)
blackleg: (blackleg OR "black leg" OR "soft rot") AND (potato OR "Solanum tuberosum") AND (Pectobacterium OR Dickeya) AND FIG:(symptom* OR blackleg OR stem* OR field)
whiterot: "Sclerotinia sclerotiorum" AND (sunflower OR "Helianthus annuus" OR rapeseed OR "Brassica napus" OR soybean) AND FIG:(symptom* OR field OR "stem rot" OR "head rot" OR "white mold" OR "white mould")
greyrot: "Botrytis cinerea" AND (grape* OR grapevine OR "Vitis vinifera" OR sunflower) AND FIG:(symptom* OR bunch* OR berr* OR "grey mould" OR "gray mold")
leafrust: "Puccinia triticina" AND FIG:(symptom* OR pustule* OR "infection type*" OR "leaf rust")
cercospora: "Cercospora beticola" AND FIG:(symptom* OR "leaf spot" OR lesion* OR field)
